visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video uses a vertical split-screen layout. The top half shows three young women dancing on a concert stage with 'IVE SERIES ASIA' displayed on the backdrop; they wear coordinated white and floral idol outfits. The bottom half features a woman with short, bright red hair wearing a pink and white maid costume with a lace headband. She sits at a polished black grand piano, her hands moving across the keys with precision against a backdrop of vertical purple curtains. (2) The top screen cuts to various medium shots and close-ups of the dancers, highlighting their smiling facial expressions, squinted eyes, and synchronized hand gestures like pointing and waving. The pianist in the bottom frame remains in a static side-view profile, her torso slightly swaying with the rhythm. The lighting in the top frame is bright and theatrical with purple and pink hues, while the bottom frame features soft, consistent indoor lighting. (3) A brief cutaway in the top frame shows a dark arena filled with a crowd of fans waving glowing pink lightsticks. The pianist continues her performance, her fingers executing fast melodic runs that align with the upbeat tempo of the dancers. Text overlays on the stage backdrop remain visible, and the overall color tone is vibrant and pastel-heavy across both frames of the video.

The visual and audio synchronization demonstrates the musician's technical skill and appreciation for the group's choreography and music.
